title: Political Cabaret Monologues and Popular Dissidence

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Budapest cabaret was an indispensable public forum. Endre Nagy is regarded as the founder of Hungarian cabaret and of the literary *konferanszié* who spoke to the audience directly. Under state socialism, Géza Hofi was one of the best-known cabaret performers; his daring asides (*kiszólások*) voiced what many in the audience thought.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Some analysts see tolerated cabaret as a *szelepfunkció* (safety valve to vent frustration); others argue that it undermined the regime. Researchers dispute which was the case.
